problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce impact of stolen credentials
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and phishing simulation exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing emails crafted using personal information to deceive specific individuals into revealing sensitive data or executing malicious actions.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify and block targeted phishing campaigns
Educate employees on recognizing personalized phishing attempts
Enforce strict verification procedures for sensitive requests

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive information from employees.
risk_reduction: Enable email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Establish verification protocols for financial transactions
Monitor email accounts for unusual activity and login anomalies

problems.description: Publicly exposed cloud storage buckets leading to data leakage or unauthorized access.
risk_reduction: Implement strict access controls and least privilege policies
Regularly audit cloud storage configurations
Use automated tools to detect and remediate misconfigurations

problems.description: Adversaries compromise software dependencies or update mechanisms to inject malicious code into widely distributed software.
risk_reduction: Implement software supply chain risk management (SCRM) practices
Use code signing and verify software integrity
Monitor software dependencies for vulnerabilities and anomalies

problems.description: Use of AI-generated synthetic media (audio/video) to impersonate trusted individuals and manipulate targets.
risk_reduction: Deploy deepfake detection tools
Establish multi-channel verification for sensitive requests
Increase awareness of synthetic media threats among employees

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model inputs to degrade or subvert machine learning model performance.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training data
Implement robust model monitoring and anomaly detection
Use adversarial training techniques to harden models

problems.description: Attackers exfiltrate sensitive data before encrypting systems and threaten to release it publicly if ransom is not paid.
risk_reduction: Implement comprehensive data backup and recovery plans
Deploy network segmentation and least privilege access
Monitor for data exfiltration indicators and unusual network activity
